questions.stem: A 56-year-old man arrives in the emergency department with severe upper gastrointestinal bleeding. On examination, he is pale, hypotensive, and has a rapid pulse. Which of the following is the initial priority in managing this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Immediate endoscopy to identify the bleeding source

options.label: B
options.text: Assessment of airway, breathing, and circulation (ABCs) with intravenous access establishment

options.label: C
options.text: Administration of terlipressin for suspected variceal bleeding

options.label: D
options.text: Blood transfusion to raise hemoglobin above 10 g/dL
